name: Sohae Satellite Launching Station
best_known_for: North Korea's satellite launch site: Unha rockets (2012, 2016) and Chollima-1 (2023)
credit: North Korea's main satellite launch site, also called Tongchang-ri, in Cholsan County, North Pyongan Province. The first launch from it was the failed Unha-3 flight of 13 April 2012 (07:39 Korea time); orbit was claimed on 12 December 2012 and 7 February 2016, and Chollima-1 reached orbit on 21 November 2023. Facts from Wikipedia (Sohae, Unha, Kwangmyongsong-3, Chollima-1); coordinates are the main pad (LP1) on Wikipedia.
